Project Overview

Building a Distinctive Automotive Brand

SHARK CAR RENTAL is a car rental brand developed from the ground up, with the ambition of establishing a distinctive and professional presence in the UAE market.

The project focused on creating a complete visual identity that reflects the brand's core attributes: power, speed, reliability, and luxury. The objective was to build a recognizable brand language that connects the name SHARK with the automotive experience while communicating confidence and professionalism across different customer touchpoints.

Market United Arab Emirates
Project Type Client Project
Creative Direction Bold & Dynamic
Brand Positioning Client Project
Brand Promise A car rental experience that brings together quality, flexibility, and trust.
02 / 10

The Challenge

As a newly established brand, SHARK needed a distinctive visual identity capable of communicating its character and positioning from the very beginning. The main challenge was to create a strong visual connection between the brand name and its automotive industry, while developing an identity that expresses power, speed, and sophistication. The goal was not simply to design a logo, but to establish a cohesive visual foundation that could support the brand across its future communications and applications.

Brand Personality

Bold, premium, professional, and modern.

Brand Values

Strength, speed, luxury, trust, freedom, safety, professionalism, comfort, and variety.

Target Audience

Tourists, residents, and businesses in the UAE seeking flexible car rental solutions across different vehicle categories and customer needs.

03 / 10

Strength & Confidence

04 / 10

Creative Concept

Inspired by the Nature of the Name

THE CORE IDEA
The shark was selected as the primary visual inspiration because of its association with strength, dominance, speed, and confidence. The concept integrates shark-inspired characteristics with automotive forms, creating a distinctive visual symbol that connects the brand name directly to its industry.

The result is a bold and dynamic identity that communicates the character of SHARK through a recognizable visual language.

Visual Identity System

A Language Built Around Power and Precision

Color Palette

The combination of black, electric blue, and white creates a strong visual contrast. Black communicates power and sophistication, while blue introduces a sense of confidence and reliability. White provides clarity and balance.

Navy Blue#1F3657
Gold#D4A24C
Soft Cream#F5F2EB
Deep Slate#2B2E34
Muted Blue#5C6F82
Light Gold#E8C98A

Typography & Graphic Elements

The typography system combines Arabic and Latin typefaces to support consistent communication across both languages. Dynamic lines, shark-inspired details, and geometric patterns extend the visual language beyond the logo.

Social Media Campaign

Extending the Brand Into Digital Communication

DIGITAL COMMUNICATION

Campaign Direction

A proposed social media campaign demonstrates how the visual identity can translate into digital marketing content. The campaign explores promotional layouts, automotive imagery, service communication, and brand-focused compositions. 10 / 10

Final Brand Experience

A Distinctive Identity for a New Automotive Brand

SHARK's visual identity brings together a bold logo concept, a distinctive color palette, dynamic graphic elements, and a flexible application system.

Every element contributes to a unified visual language designed to communicate strength, speed, reliability, and professionalism. The complete identity system was presented to the client and approved without revisions. The project establishes a strong visual foundation for SHARK CAR RENTAL and its future brand communications.
